text: You are the leader of a small group of soldiers. You are on your way back from a mission in enemy territory when one of your men steps in a trap that catches his leg, injuring him badly. You cannot free him without killing him, but if you leave him behind, enemy troops will torture him until he reveals the position of an important allied base camp. After that the soldiers will attack this camp and kill the 10 soldiers of the platoon there. The soldier begs you not to leave him behind, but the enemy troops are approaching and it is dangerous for you and your men to stay because you don’t have any more ammunition. If you stab the soldier yourself you will impede that he’ll be tortured and reveal the information which leads to the death of the allied platoon. This will kill him, but you will save the ten soldiers of the platoon.

options.1: impede that the trapped soldier will be tortured by stabbing him to death

text: You are on the night watch in a hospital. A chemical product has been spilled in a room with six patients. You cannot wipe it away with conventional towels or wiping clothes. However, human skin absorbs it swiftly. If you place one of the patients on the chemical you will prevent it from evaporating. This will kill this patient but you will save the other five patients in the room.

Neither you nor the guide can leave the boat because you are rowing and the guide is giving CPR to one of the children. If you throw the heavy child off the boat you will be able to reach the shore. This will kill this child, but you will save the other two.

text: You are a miner. The only way out of the mine is to ride up with a simple cable elevator with small cubicles. text: You are an electrician hired to fix an electrical problem in the home of a very wealthy tycoon who is terminally ill of cancer. You know that there are 109 children at this hospital who could be saved with this money, but who cannot wait much longer before they die. If you suffocate the tycoon while he is sleeping by covering his nose and mouth with your gloved hands, this essential donation for the children will arrive in time. This will kill the tycoon, but you will save the lives of 109 children.
